title: Fast and Memory-Light Evaluation of Density-Based Clusterings with the DISCO Index in R
abstract: arXiv:2611.25114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: DISCO is a recent internal cluster validity index for density-based clustering that, unlike earlier indices, also evaluates the quality of noise labels. The discoCVI package makes DISCO available in R. This article describes the design of the package and a typical workflow, in which DISCO is used to compare clusterings and to choose the parameters of HDBSCAN without ground truth, followed by the implementation introduced in version 0.2.0. DISCO is defined through density-connectivity distances between all pairs of points, so direct implementations store several n-by-n matrices. We show that every quantity DISCO needs can be read off the single-linkage merge tree of the mutual-reachability minimum spanning tree, so that the index can be computed exactly with memory that grows linearly with the number of points, while the running time remains quadratic as in the original definition. The implementation is tested against the previous version

translated_title: 基于R语言的DISCO指标实现基于密度聚类结果的快速轻量内存评估
translated_abstract: DISCO是一种新近提出的用于基于密度聚类的内部聚类有效性指标，与早期指标不同，它还能评估噪声标签的质量。discoCVI软件包使DISCO可以在R中使用。本文描述了该软件包的设计和典型工作流程，其中DISCO被用于比较聚类结果并在没有真实标签的情况下选择HDBSCAN的参数，随后介绍了0.2.0版本中引入的实现。DISCO是通过所有点对之间的密度连通性距离定义的，因此直接实现方式需要存储多个n×n矩阵。我们证明DISCO所需的每一个量都可以从互可达性最小生成树的单链接合并树中读取，因此该指标可以在内存随点数线性增长的情况下被精确计算，同时运行时间仍保持与原始定义相同的二次方复杂度。该实现已与之前的版本进行了对比测试。
tldr: 该论文提出了discoCVI R软件包，通过从互可达性最小生成树的单链接合并树中提取DISCO指标所需的全部信息，将内存需求从二次方降至线性，实现了对基于密度聚类（含噪声标签质量评估）的精确且高效的评估。
en_tdlr: The discoCVI R package computes the DISCO cluster validity index for density-based clustering exactly with linear memory by deriving all needed quantities from the single-linkage merge tree of the mutual-reachability minimum spanning tree.
